snippet.title: Monsterest – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the demo on Steam: http://s.team/a/2895410
Join the community: http://discord.gg/sq3EpqQMGD

Manage a monster-friendly inn. Every day, a new monster guest visits. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. You'll need to catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Satisfied guests will return to your inn next time.
